text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: Page delivered to hana: streaming endpoint p99 > 4s in us-east-1, inflight streams increasing rapidly. Affected pool: us-east-1-prod-stream. Incident tag: STREAM-LAT-1793

hana (oncall): ack. jumping in. quinn, mike, can you pull logs and check whether this is routing or backend saturation? Any visible customer errors?

quinn: logs show a mix of very long streaming sessions and many tiny sessions that keep opening and never finishing. KV-cache eviction rate spiked. throughput for streaming path is the bottleneck; sync endpoints are fine. Could be a misbehaving client or a config regression.

mike: joining. Quick mitigation choices: 1) regional streaming toggle off 2) per-route quota bump-down for streaming requests 3) pausing accept for new streaming sessions and letting existing finish 4) reroute streaming to a cheaper variant (non-streaming)

hana (oncall): prefer option 3 -> pause new streaming connections, because it avoids immediate mass-fallbacks and gives clients time. If queue doesn't drop, we can escalate to full disable. Inform support about possible degraded chat UX.

infra-bot: Executing: redwoodctl streaming pause --region us-east-1 --action pause-new --reason "mitigation STREAM-LAT-1793" by quinn at 1793318734. Status: OK. New streaming session acceptance paused; existing streams allowed to finish.

quinn: metrics: new streaming connection rate went to zero, inflight streams slowly decaying from 28k -> 9k in 45s. p99 latency trending downward but still above SLO.

hana (oncall): good. Apply a short-lived per-tenant soft quota to the top 20 noisy tenants to prevent them from opening many sync fallbacks. We don't want a thundering herd when clients switch. Mike, can you run that?

mike: running emergency quotas. Command:

```
redwoodctl quota apply --region us-east-1 --tenants file:top20-noisy.json --type soft --rate 8r/s --burst 20 --ttl 15m
```

support-bot: Sending proactive notice to affected customers in us-east-1. Banner added on status page: "Degraded streaming responses in US-East; temporary mitigations in progress."

arnold: note: some mobile SDK versions aggressively retry on streaming failures; devex has a client patch available to map E-STREAM-FALLBACK to a non-retryable code. Devex folks please coordinate with support.

devex: noted. prepping patch and a short doc showing how to detect E-STREAM-FALLBACK and fall back gracefully. Will post link.

hana (oncall): observation window 12 minutes. If backlog not below target we'll flip streaming off region-wide. Quinn, what's the rollback plan if things worsen after a full disable?

quinn: rollback is to re-enable accepting streaming sessions and revert the quotas. We'll also have a staged re-enable path: re-open acceptance, then increase sampled streaming traffic via percentage flags. If we flip off, clients will receive E-STREAM-FALLBACK and may retry; our quotas should protect against replay storms.

infra-bot: Alert: inflight streams at 9k; p99 moving toward 2.1s from 4.3s. CPU utilization dropping. Next check at 1793318748.

mike: inflight queue at 6.4k now. On track. If stable at next check, runbook recommends partial re-enable by model family at 5% traffic first.

hana (oncall): agreed. Keep watch. I'm handing active watch to arnold for the next 20m. Arnold, if p99 dips back under 1.2s and queue <2k, execute staged re-enable plan.

arnold: taking watch. I will not re-enable until we see stable metrics for 3 consecutive checks. Also I'll coordinate with devex to ensure clients get clear UX messaging.

infra-bot: check-in 1793318748: inflight 3.1k, p99 1.5s, CPU nominal. All trending good.

arnold: ok initiating canary: enable streaming for model family 'chat-family-a' at 5% in us-east-1. Command:

```
redwoodctl feature percent-enable --region us-east-1 --feature streaming --model "chat-family-a" --percent 5 --actor arnold
```

infra-bot: Canary enabled at 1793318754. 5% of new chat-family-a sessions will attempt streaming path.

arnold: early canary telemetry: 5% traffic stable, no p99 regression; inflight stream count steady. Will increase to 20% in 5m if stable.

hana (oncall): thanks everyone. Post-incident follow-ups:
- RCA: analyze client retry patterns and SDK behavior (devex + support)
- Cache tuning to mitigate KV eviction storms (sre + infra)
- Add runbook step for "pause new streaming acceptance" as first mitigation (ops)

hana (oncall): handing pager back to me at 1793318758. Mitigation succeeded, moving to monitoring and RCA. :white_check_mark:
